title: SharePoint Online Permissions & Access Management
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft 365 SharePoint administration).

SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Get SharePoint permissions under control — no more broken inheritance
problem: SharePoint permissions rot into a tangle of broken inheritance, unique permissions, and over-shared sites nobody can audit. This solution establishes a permissions and access model: group-based access (SharePoint groups + Entra/M365 groups), a standard permission-level model, controlling unique permissions and broken inheritance, site-access reviews, and access reporting — so who-can-see-what is intentional and auditable.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the permission model: SharePoint groups vs Entra/M365 groups, permission levels, inheritance vs unique permissions, access reviews, and reporting.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (SPO admin, group source of truth, IA/site structure, governance stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — define the group-based model + permission levels, remediate broken inheritance/unique permissions, wire site-access reviews, and stand up access reporting — pilot-first, each group/level named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (access group-based, inheritance intact where intended, over-share reduced) plus Best Practices for durable permission hygiene.
short: Establish a SharePoint permissions & access model — group-based access, standard permission levels, controlled unique-permissions/broken-inheritance, access reviews, and reporting — so access is intentional and auditable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Establish a SharePoint permissions & access model — group-based access, standard permission levels, controlled unique-permissions/broken-inheritance, access reviews, and reporting — so access is intentional and auditable.

bottom_line: SharePoint access made intentional and auditable — group-based, standard permission levels, broken inheritance remediated, reviews running — the permission tangle untangled.
